title: Essentials Targets
description: Wallach's 90 essentials with daily/clinical target ranges. Source-rule.md governs the `source` field: every entry must cite a Wallach-corpus or Youngevity-primary reference.

source.description: REQUIRED by source-rule.md. Must cite a Wallach-corpus or Youngevity-primary reference. Validator is in warn-only mode until backfill complete; then required.

wallach_stance.description: Wallach's editorial voice on this essential — the pull-quote that leads the detail panel and reframes the tile as a teaching moment rather than just a deficiency target. Single canonical quote per essential by curation discipline. Optional field; absence renders nothing (graceful degradation per doctrine §7). Added Round 115 (Wallach-stance Phase 1 infrastructure).

quote.description: Wallach's words on this essential. Paraphrase only with explicit '[paraphrase]' marker; prefer verbatim. Per source-rule cornerstone, the quote must come from a Wallach-corpus primary.

citation.description: Book + chapter, transcript + timestamp, or episode reference. Specific enough that a reader can verify the source.

context.description: Optional descriptive setting for the quote ('from the chapter on osteoporosis', 'during the Q&A on amino-acid supplementation'). Helps a reader understand the frame without needing to load the citation.

expanded_context.description: Optional fuller passage (Round 124 — read-more popup feature). When a pull-quote benefits from surrounding argument context that doesn't fit cleanly in a 2-3 sentence excerpt, expanded_context carries the longer passage. Surfaces via a 'Read more' affordance next to the citation; click opens a modal showing this content. Per source-rule cornerstone, expanded_context content is a Wallach claim displayed and must come from a Wallach-corpus primary (same allowlist as the quote field). Absence renders no read-more affordance (graceful degradation per doctrine §7). Most stances will not need this field; reserved for cases where the pull-quote's argument materially depends on context that would inflate the tile's primary display.
